newsitem.title: ESTONIA: POHJOLA EYES LATVIAN, LITHUANIAN MARKETS.
newsitem.headline: POHJOLA EYES LATVIAN, LITHUANIAN MARKETS.

text.p: Finnish insurance company Pohjola said on Thursday that it wanted to enter the Latvian life-insurance and the Lithuanian non-life insurance markets.
"We are looking at life-insurance (in Latvia) after our experiences in Estonia," Pohjola vice-president Jyrki Hagglund told Reuters.
"We are looking extensively at the possibilites in Lithuania and hope that (entering the market) will happen during this year," he added.
Pohjola has a 44-percent stake in Latvian non-life insurer Fanlat. The other shareholders are AIG with share of 44 percent and Estonian Seesam with 10 percent.
Pohjola earlier signed an agreement to buy 30 percent of Estonian life-insurer Seesam-Elu, whose parent company is Seesam.
